purpose: Original generated albedo/opacity sources for authored Land geometry, not measured scans or a reconstructed terrain.

images.brief: Orthographic overhead meadow grass/clover albedo, fine blades, restrained green/olive/straw variation, even diffuse illumination, compatible tile edges; no scene, path, tree, pond, border or text.
Single photorealistic overhead mid-green oak leaf with veins, short downward stem, tip upward, even neutral lighting and transparent alpha outside the leaf; no tree, branch, scene, shadow or text.

limitations: Generated albedo/opacity images, not scanned material. Terrain, pond and branches are authored geometry. Soil/bark and micro-normal/roughness/ripple maps are deterministic visual approximations, not surveyed geology or measured surface data. Tiling and collection fidelity require rendered review.
